Details of your request
Requested character
Nakula.
He is a cool looking man.
In everyday life, he is an ordinary company employee,
He is an ordinary company employee in daily life, but he also has a secret side where he undertakes undercover operations, espionage, and assassinations.
He is not interested in other people and is not sociable,
He is not interested in other people and is unsociable, but he laughs a lot and is very sweet to those who get to know him.
He also has a mischievous side.

(Please refer to the following URL for reference images.
(Please refer to the URL of the image for reference. https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1o-suqUp9rJv1jJIX5uErvv9bYWSIan31?usp=sharing)

Usage
Activities on Youtube, Twitch, etc. (video clips, streaming, thumbnails, etc.)
Activities on social networking sites such as X (Twitter) and promotional posts
Use in merchandise and online print distribution (if this is not allowed, we would appreciate it if you could write it down somewhere on the layer).

Please include the following information.
If there is an address or background, it would be greatly appreciated if you could provide a transparent image of the person only.
We would very much appreciate your consideration.
